tierBands.label: Planned or governance-only
tierBands.meaning: Project is registered for governance/readiness but has no audited operator surface yet.

tierBands.label: Raw legacy surface
tierBands.meaning: Dashboard exists as a raw report, debug table, prototype, or ungoverned screen.

tierBands.label: Adapter-aligned shell
tierBands.meaning: Canonical CSS/static adapter is synced, but no surface-level component inventory is enforceable.

tierBands.label: Inventoried one-shell report
tierBands.meaning: One-shell route and surfaces are inventoried, but the main operator path still reads as a report.

tierBands.label: Hybrid shared-component dashboard
tierBands.meaning: Primary surface uses shared-kit contracts through a static or hybrid implementation, but is not fully package-native.

tierBands.label: Package-native shared-component dashboard
tierBands.meaning: Primary surface imports shared components directly and covers required states, but is not yet a product-grade cockpit.

tierBands.label: Cockpit candidate with review gaps
tierBands.meaning: Dashboard targets product-grade cockpit behavior but still has Tier 3 visual, shell, chart, proof, or interaction warnings.

tierBands.label: Current static/hybrid product cockpit
tierBands.meaning: Audited product-grade cockpit is current, but delivery still depends on static or hybrid adapter infrastructure.

tierBands.label: Package-native product cockpit
tierBands.meaning: Highest maturity: audited Tier 3 cockpit implemented directly with shared package components and complete proof/validation.

projects.name: Kashi VC
projects.nextMove: Repair Tier 3 visual/shell/chart markers in the live command surface; then plan package-native route migration.

projects.name: Media Engine
projects.nextMove: Preserve as the current static/hybrid Tier 3 reference; next maturity step is package-native implementation.

projects.name: Media Business OS
projects.nextMove: Add surface inventory, pick primary recipe, define data/state contracts, then build shared-component cockpit.

projects.name: Business Mapper
projects.nextMove: Add surface inventory and migrate primary dashboard path to shared components.

projects.name: Meal Assistant
projects.nextMove: Add surface inventory, define the product cockpit routes, and migrate away from hand-authored server-rendered dashboard HTML/CSS.

projects.name: Hermes OS
projects.nextMove: Decide whether Hermes OS owns a production operator dashboard or remains governance-only; if dashboard-owned, add surfaces and target package-native cockpit.

projects.name: TLC Capital Group OS
projects.nextMove: Inventory executive/operator surfaces and define whether this becomes a package-native cockpit or remains a readiness consumer.
